rows.purpose: Falsify numerical/gradient equivalence and measure actual source microbatch compute cost before any integration.

notes: Write C_y=Q+BKK^TB^T where Q=C-BB^T is strictly SPD under the existing stored mode margin. Factor AQA^T+noiseI without gradients; only a64x64 factor carries covariance-head gradients.

The original coupled model is not edited, resumed or re-trained. No target data, predictions, route or optimizer are involved.
